rules.statement: The bond tendered as security for respondents' costs is invalid if it does not conform with the requirements of section 2 of Ordinance No. 7 of 1840 or Ordinance No. 17 of 1852.
rules.supporting_quote: "I accordingly hold that the bond in this case is invalid, as it does not conform with the requirements of section 2 of Ordinance No. 7 of 1840, or of Ordinance No. 17 of 1852."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 2 of Ordinance No. 7 of 1840 or Ordinance No. 17 of 1852
